Grab this great job opportunity in the warehouse for 32 to 40 hours a week. You start right away in day shifts. From September, you switch to 2 shifts and earn extra shift allowances! ⚡

What we offer
- Good salary based on CAO
- Work for 32 to 40 hours per week
- Travel costs paid
- Free courses via Tempo-Team
- Friendly team and nice workplace

Who you are
- You currently live in the Netherlands
- You want to work in Waalwijk
- You are available to work 32 to 40 hours per week
- You can work in 2 shifts starting from September
- You speak English or Dutch
- You are active, fit, and like hands-on work

What will you do
As a Warehouse Employee, you make sure all products go to the right place. You stay active and busy on the warehouse floor. ⚙️

- 📦 Picking items using a hand scanner
- 🏷️ Packing boxes and making them ready to send
- 🔍 Checking incoming and outgoing goods
- 🧹 Keeping your work area clean and safe

Where will you work
You will work at a friendly and growing company in Waalwijk. Together with your colleagues, you form a great team. 🏭 You start immediately in regular day shifts. From September, you switch to 2 shifts. This gives you flexible hours and extra money on top of your pay! 🔥

Job application
Application Process 🚀
- Click the button and send your details.
- Check your WhatsApp and answer a few quick questions.
- Schedule your online interview yourself with Tempo-Team at a time that works best for you!  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent.

Earn big as a warehouse worker at DSV in Venlo! With a starting salary of € 15,55 per hour plus extra shift allowances after 7:00 PM, you're set up for success. You will work full-time in a friendly team where the day flies by. See yourself shining in this role? Read on and apply directly!

What we offer
- A salary of € 15,55 per hour!
- After 7:00 PM you earn €19,53 per hour!
- Working in 2 shifts!
- Travel allowance!
- A job with career opportunities!
- An in-house Tempo-Team office!

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you, as a warehouse employee, meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch and/or English.
- You have your own transport.
- You are physically able to lift boxes up to 20 kilos if necessary.
- You are available within a week.

What will you do
Are you going to work as a warehouse worker at DSV? Then you get started with an English voice picking system! You will be told via this system which products you need to collect. You will also be told which location to take this to! You take the products and stack them on a pallet. Then you seal it closed. Everything is ready to ship! As an order picker you are very flexible. You don't mind helping out in another department every now and then! One team, one task! Do you also want to continue growing after a while? That's possible! Who knows, you might end up being the new team leader! :)

- Workdays: Monday to Friday.
- Worktimes: in two shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM and from 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM.

Where will you work
As a warehouse worker at DSV, you will work in a large warehouse. This location can be found at Popeweg 50 in Venlo. Do you have your own car, scooter or bicycle? This makes the location easy to reach! You also occasionally work at different locations. But luckily you are flexible! You don't work alone in this large warehouse, but with a super fun team!

Are you an experienced roofer or roof tiler looking for a varied job where craftsmanship, teamwork, and quality come first? Then we'd love to meet you!

Your working day starts at our warehouse in Oudkarspel, where you meet your colleagues to go over the day's schedule and prepare the materials needed for the project. Together, you travel to the job site where you'll be working from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM renovating the roofs of existing homes.

No two days are the same. One day you'll be removing an old roof structure, while the next you'll be installing new roof tiles, fitting insulation materials, or carrying out various carpentry tasks. Every project offers new challenges, and at the end of the day, you'll see the results of your craftsmanship reflected in the finished roof.

You'll be part of a close-knit and supportive team where everyone works together to deliver high-quality results. Helping one another comes naturally, and safety, quality, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.

We also believe in investing in our people. That's why we offer plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career. You'll have the chance to obtain certifications such as VCA, MEWP (Mobile Elevated Work Platform), and crane operator certificates, as well as attend a range of professional training courses to further expand your expertise.

Are you an experienced roofer or roof tiler who enjoys working outdoors, takes pride in delivering quality workmanship, and thrives in a team environment? We'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact us for more information!

- You have experience with roofing work
- You have your own transport to the warehouse in Oudkarspel
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are willing to work in a team
- Experience with tile laying is a plus
